title: Blondie
scene: New York CBGB punk and early new wave
notes: Brisk New York punk-pop recasts sixties girl groups with sly vocals and sharp guitars.

title: Plastic Letters
scene: New York punk and first-wave new wave

title: Parallel Lines
scene: New York new wave crossing into international pop and disco

title: Eat to the Beat
scene: Post-punk-era mainstream new wave and disco-rock
